rules.text: If the parenthetical percentages inscribed inside the pie slices are the dashboard's current Europe smartphone market-share values and each inscription is attached to its named brand, then Apple’s printed 45% exceeds Xiaomi’s 30%, Samsung’s 15%, and Others’ 10%. If the promotion rule selects the brand with the highest current market share, the matching Apple promotion option is supported.

rules.text: If the pie-slice angular areas, rather than the parenthetical inscriptions, are intended to encode the same market-share metric, visibly unequal slice areas that do not align with the printed percentage ordering create a support gap. A choice cannot be confirmed from the chart until it is established whether the labels or the slice geometry are authoritative.
